name: duration-text
title: Duration text
description: A duration in few characters that still reads in full aloud: 1h 30m for the eye, 1 hour, 30 minutes for the ear, with an ISO 8601 value for machines.
docs: Built on the Intl number and list formats, not the newer duration format, so the server and the browser write the same text. format is narrow, short, long or clock; largestUnit and maxUnits decide how much is written, and the rest is cut, not rounded. Zero reads 0m.
